moho_features.bone_influence: bone strength / region of influence (Moho bones)
moho_features.layer_binding: a whole layer bound to one bone
moho_features.point_binding: individual vector or mesh points bound to one bone
moho_features.flexi_binding: smooth influence of several bones (falloff by bone strength)
moho_features.mesh_warping: Smart Warp / mesh deformation of image layers
moho_features.smart_bones: actions driven by a bone angle (corrective shapes over an angle range)

rows.feature: RIGID garment parts (shoes, hands, head, shirt cuffs)
rows.note: one layer per part bound to its bone; the cuff stays on the forearm layer

rows.feature: rigid decorative overlays (badge, buttons, tie, pocket flaps)
rows.note: bound to the nearest torso bone; the rigid fit of a bending torso is lost

rows.feature: FLEXIBLE rigid segments (upper/forearm sleeve, trouser shin)
rows.note: segments become separate layers (the cut follows the joint plane, not the Phase 1 layer cut); needs a layer split in Phase 4

rows.feature: weighted joint patch (wedge fill at elbows, knees, shoulders)
rows.note: a Smart Warp mesh from the weight grid with points bound to their dominant bone; angle interpolation becomes linear point binding (more pinching)
Moho binds a point to one bone (or uses flexi falloff); fractional per-vertex weights do not import. Export keeps them as data only

rows.feature: LIMITED torso deformation (spine/chest bands, clavicle shrug)
rows.note: bone strength radii approximate the band widths
bone origins at the aligned pivots (already in the exported bones)
a Smart Bone action per trigger over its angle range; drawings must exist and be approved first

rows.feature: generated pixels drawn beneath their occluder
rows.note: extensions are separate layers placed under the occluding layer

rows.feature: hem lag / hair sway secondary motion
rows.note: needs a per-frame script or baked keys (allowlisted API only)

rows.feature: patch stretch-limit clipping and distortion evaluation

notes: Moho did not run in this phase; nothing here is verified in Moho
no Moho Lua API names are introduced; a native exporter is Phase 4
per-vertex weights are not assumed to import into Moho
